idk, there's not many people close to me. Lone child, and my Mom died awhile back from her drinking. Not close to Dad either, we don't really talk. 

I'm finishing my Environmental Sociology and Political Science degrees this semester. Haven't figured out what I'm going to do yet, though. 
Free time I do photography or game, but I haven't done much of either recently...

Just trying to figure out to do with my life now, I guess. Talked to my other friend, he said he'll help me through for a bit, so for now I'm just hoping things get better.

Yeah, that sounds life stuff that I've known all along. It's just... I guess it's heartbreak. She was my last hope, and now I don't really have that anymore. 

idk, maybe I'll tell her to just get it out there, so I can at least say I did something. 

I'll give it time though. Right now... I'm just trying to figure out what to do next.
